about_the_game:
It is a visual novel AVG with a female beta as the protagonist.

(1) At a noisy drinking party at the end of a job, you will start the story and gradually learn about the experiences of the protagonist and the people he cares about, and decide how they end in the story.

(2) You can read the text by clicking the left mouse button, scroll wheel sliding, space bar, etc.

(3) There are 5 endings in this article, with a total word count of 37W, and the CG number does not include a difference of 100; The single-line customs clearance time is about 6~8 hours, and the time required to recover a single ending after archiving is about 1~2 hours;

There are a total of 4 endings, the total number of words is 5W, and the CG number does not include a difference of 10; The customs clearance time is about 1~2 hours.

Main characters

Protagonist (you):

Beta, age unknown.

The protagonist who always smiles.

I worked for a large company with an amazing work intensity, and the salary was very considerable, and there were basically no material difficulties.

？？？ ：

The existence you care about the most.

No matter what, you sincerely hope that she can be happy.

Precautions

Make good use of your archives. Due to the engine, when fast-forwarding/intensive operation/connecting points, there may be abnormal game stuttering, missing paragraphs/vertical painting displaying abnormalities.

Thank you for your support and every comment you have made will be a great encouragement to me.

content_descriptors.notes: The work may depict the dark psychology of some characters and the suicidal tendencies revealed in their words, so players are asked to distinguish the boundary between fiction and reality and strive to live.
